coverage_summary: The four inference routes are represented with appropriate ControlNet, text-encoding, denoising, and VAE boundaries. Several unresolved details are preserved, but the zero-shot bypass and some tensor/model-state assertions exceed the paper evidence.

findings.detail: The trajectory labels DAPI and H&E routes as model variants without preserving whether they are separate trained configurations or routes through one unified model.

evidence.quote: These prompts enable flexible task conditioning within a unified framework

findings.required_change: Mark the trained-configuration identity as unresolved and label these as route/task contexts unless the paper establishes separate configurations.

findings.detail: The semantic_features node asserts ordered text-position axes, although the paper only documents a set of semantic feature vectors and does not establish token positions, pooling, or tensor layout.

evidence.quote: a transformer-based text encoder processes the natural language query to generate a set of semantic feature vectors

findings.required_change: Use a generic semantic-feature index or leave the axes unspecified; retain the tokenizer, pooling, and representation uncertainty.

findings.detail: The semantic_features_protein node makes the same unsupported ordered-text-position claim.

evidence.quote: a transformer-based text encoder processes the natural language query to generate a set of semantic feature vectors

findings.required_change: Replace the ordered text-position axis with an unspecified or generic semantic-feature axis.

findings.detail: The semantic_features_rna node makes the same unsupported ordered-text-position claim.

evidence.quote: a transformer-based text encoder processes the natural language query to generate a set of semantic feature vectors

findings.required_change: Replace the ordered text-position axis with an unspecified or generic semantic-feature axis.

findings.detail: The conditional zero-shot semantic_features node also asserts ordered text positions even though prompt presence and the model-visible representation are unresolved.

evidence.quote: Simultaneously, a user-defined text prompt specifying the molecular target is processed by a text encoder to produce semantic features.

findings.required_change: Keep the node conditional, but leave its tensor axes unspecified or use a generic semantic-feature index.

findings.detail: The zero-convolution calls set parameter_state to trainable. The paper establishes zero initialization and a trainable encoder copy, but does not explicitly state that the zero-convolution layers themselves are trainable.

evidence.quote: It achieves this by creating a trainable copy of the diffusion model's encoder blocks
These features are passed through 'zero convolution' layers (1x1 convolutions initialized with zeros)

findings.required_change: Record zero initialization and leave zero-convolution trainability unspecified unless the source explicitly establishes it.

findings.detail: The protein-route zero-convolution call makes the same unsupported trainability assertion.

evidence.quote: These features are passed through 'zero convolution' layers (1x1 convolutions initialized with zeros)

findings.required_change: Leave zero-convolution trainability unspecified while retaining the documented 1x1 zero initialization.

findings.detail: The RNA-route zero-convolution call makes the same unsupported trainability assertion.

evidence.quote: These features are passed through 'zero convolution' layers (1x1 convolutions initialized with zeros)

findings.required_change: Leave zero-convolution trainability unspecified while retaining the documented 1x1 zero initialization.

findings.detail: The zero-shot denoising step asserts a bypass from semantic features when no prompt is supplied. The route-specific methods text says only that H&E patch directories were used; it does not establish either prompt absence or bypass behavior.

evidence.quote: In the second stage, we used the directories of H&E patches as input to our TissueCraftAI model.
A conditioning image (e.g., H&E or DAPI) is processed by a ControlNet image encoder to extract spatial and morphological features.

findings.required_change: Remove the asserted bypass. Preserve the text-conditioning status as unresolved at the opaque denoising boundary unless the paper documents an absent-prompt branch.
